clusters.name: Base44 AI app-building masterclass
clusters.description: Course that teaches aspiring no-code builders to make SaaS apps, websites, agents and mobile apps with Base44. It lists at $499 and is often given away free as a lead magnet.

clusters.name: Accredited / niche vocational trade school
clusters.description: Accredited or specialised vocational schools (electrical, HVAC, welding, plumbing, court reporting, flight attendant, marine and similar) that train career changers. Revenue is tuition, often paid through federal or state aid.

clusters.name: Grant-funded online certification/trade school
clusters.description: Online or white-labelled vocational certification courses (forklift, HVAC VR, dental assisting, solar, EV, dog grooming, prison programmes) sold to displaced workers and young people. Revenue is per-student tuition, mostly reimbursed by state workforce grants or nonprofits.

clusters.name: IT school plus staffing placement
clusters.description: An IT training school combined with a staffing company. Grants fund each student's training, and employers pay placement fees when graduates are hired.

clusters.name: Playmakers AI agency community
clusters.description: Paid community that teaches aspiring AI agency owners to sell AI implementation services to local businesses. Revenue is membership fees.

clusters.name: Codie's Boardroom / business-owner advisory ladder
clusters.description: A tiered offer ladder for established business owners: free content and workshops, then a paid academy or community, then high-ticket Boardroom advisory.

clusters.name: Paid business-builder community
clusters.description: Membership community for people starting and growing businesses, offering Q&As, AMAs, Slack, calls and exclusive content. Revenue is monthly subscriptions.

clusters.name: Niche passion paid membership community
clusters.description: A community built around a niche interest (resellers, blue-collar stoicism, and similar) for enthusiasts. Members pay a monthly fee, sometimes supplemented by merchandise.

clusters.name: One-off consulting / coaching sessions
clusters.description: Short paid advice sessions or recurring calls for people who want expert help, with upsells to coaching packages or retainers.

clusters.name: Micro-niche skill knowledge selling
clusters.description: Monetising very specific hobby or skill knowledge (LEGO building, Pokémon card grading, vacuuming) through consulting or training.

clusters.name: AI-leveraged expertise consulting
clusters.description: Using existing career expertise plus AI research to package courses, deliverables and consulting for clients in a field. Revenue is consulting and course fees.

clusters.name: AI training for executives and business teams
clusters.description: Executive briefings, office workshops, local seminars and fractional AI-officer coaching that help businesses adopt AI. Revenue comes from per-event fees, retainers and implementation upsells.

clusters.name: AI learning cohorts and programmes
clusters.description: Group cohorts, programmes or communities where individuals and small-business owners learn to build with AI and automate their work. Revenue is cohort or membership fees.

clusters.name: AI / social media digital courses
clusters.description: Low-ticket digital courses and webinars teaching AI video and social content to an existing audience. Revenue is one-off product sales.

clusters.name: How-to-start-a-business course/playbook
clusters.description: Operators sell courses, playbooks, books or kits teaching others to start their specific business model (storage yards, cleaning, couch flipping, stump grinding, tree service, magnets and others). Revenue is one-off course sales, sometimes with a community.

clusters.name: Operator coaching / licensing programme for trade businesses
clusters.description: Ongoing coaching, mentoring, licensing or training-plus-software programmes for people running a specific business type (home services, detailing, Amazon Influencer, insurance agents).

clusters.name: Homesteading / hobby farming education
clusters.description: Courses, memberships, classes, speaking and kit subscriptions that teach goat keeping, homesteading or mushroom growing to hobbyists.

clusters.name: Tutoring services
clusters.description: Hourly or centre-based academic tutoring, including executive-function support, for students and their families.

clusters.name: Local skill lessons and classes
clusters.description: Paid private or group lessons in practical or recreational skills (music, swimming, dog training, dance, woodworking, DIY, kids' online classes).

clusters.name: Mailed DIY practice kits with video course
clusters.description: Practice repair kits shipped to non-handy homeowners, paired with a video course. Revenue is one-off kit-plus-course sales.

clusters.name: Sewing-machine repair online academy
clusters.description: Online course with live support teaching people to repair their own sewing machines. Revenue is course or programme fees.

clusters.name: General business skills education
clusters.description: Courses, events or schools teaching entrepreneurs sales, negotiation, operations and launching businesses.

clusters.name: Niche personal / executive coaching
clusters.description: High-ticket coaching for a specific group, such as executives, divorced dads or hormone-health clients. Revenue is coaching packages and programmes.

clusters.name: College admissions services for families
clusters.description: Essay help, admissions coaching and tuition-negotiation services sold to parents and high-school students. Revenue is packages, coaching fees or success fees.

clusters.name: Book publishing education and book-led funnels
clusters.description: Helping authors write, publish and launch books, and using books and webinars to drive courses and events.

clusters.name: Customer-acquisition partnership and podcast-guesting training
clusters.description: Teaching people to win customers through partner audiences and podcast guest appearances. Revenue is high-ticket education.

clusters.name: Copywriting / ghostwriting academy
clusters.description: Courses and communities that teach copywriting or ghostwriting and give feedback on members' work, sometimes alongside an agency.

clusters.name: Newsletter audience courses, cohorts and events
clusters.description: Monetising an email newsletter audience by selling courses, paid cohorts, events and recruiting placement fees.

clusters.name: Gig-role training and recruitment
clusters.description: Training people to become mystery shoppers or construction draw inspectors and connecting them with work. Revenue is training fees and recruiting.

clusters.name: CPR training company
clusters.description: CPR certification training for healthcare workers and facilities, delivered by subcontracted instructors. Revenue is per-person and per-facility fees.

clusters.name: Executive writing training
clusters.description: Course teaching salespeople and sales leaders to write briefs for senior executives, delivered under an employer contract.

clusters.name: Credit and bank funding advisory
clusters.description: Education and coaching that helps business owners and investors build credit profiles and secure bank funding.

clusters.name: Wine / sommelier expertise
clusters.description: Specialist wine tasting knowledge and credentials used to guide buyers across price tiers.

clusters.name: Simulation theory class
clusters.description: A one-off class teaching simulation theory to students.

clusters.name: Buying founder-brand info businesses (caution)
clusters.description: Warning against acquiring personal-brand coaching, course or agency businesses whose revenue depends on the founder's followers.

clusters.name: Free-first case study to land first AI client
clusters.description: Advice for aspiring AI consultants to solve one real problem for free, build a case study, then raise prices.
